headerDisplay: Configure your Tapo smart devices with an easy-to-use interface. This plugin supports automatic device discovery and encrypted credential storage, plus optional Secret Request for credential-free operation.
footerDisplay: For support and documentation, visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/stoyanov-x/homebridge-tapo-stoyanov).

credentialType.title: Credential Type
credentialType.description: How to provide Tapo credentials: Traditional stores encrypted credentials on disk, Secret Request delivers them via iPhone push notification

email.title: TP-Link Account Email
email.description: Your TP-Link/Tapo account email address (encrypted) - Required for Traditional mode only

password.title: TP-Link Account Password
password.description: Your TP-Link/Tapo account password (encrypted) - Required for Traditional mode only

isEncrypted.title: Credentials Encrypted
isEncrypted.description: Whether credentials are encrypted (managed automatically by UI)

secretName.title: Secret Name
secretName.description: Name of the secret stored in iOS Keychain (e.g., 'tapo-admin') - Required for Secret Request mode

secretServerUrl.title: Secret Request Server URL
secretServerUrl.description: URL of the secret-request server - Required for Secret Request mode

secretTimeout.title: Secret Request Timeout (seconds)
secretTimeout.description: How long to wait for secret approval on iPhone (1-48 hours)

secretApiKey.title: API Key (Optional)
secretApiKey.description: API key for authentication with the Secret Request server. Can also be set via SECRET_API_KEY environment variable.

name.title: Device Name
name.description: Friendly name for the device. For IR Remotes, this must match the remote's nickname in the Tapo app (or set the thingName below).

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: Local IP address of the device. Required for Light Bulbs; not needed for IR Remotes (they are controlled via the cloud).

type.title: Device Type
type.description: Type of Tapo device. IR Remote exposes a paired IR remote (e.g. a TV or speaker) from the Tapo H110 hub as a HomeKit Television.

thingName.title: IR Remote Thing Name (Optional)
thingName.description: IR Remote only: the cloud thingName of the IR remote (e.g. '802D3E1478A92CEA8BF45E3034FE94D9237E02B7030B0002'). When omitted, the remote is matched by its decoded nickname. You can find the thingName from the plugin logs after discovery.

irKeys.title: Exposed IR Source Keys (Optional)
irKeys.description: IR Remote only: optional list of IR SOURCE key names to expose as HomeKit inputs (e.g. ['LINE1', 'LINE2', 'Bluetooth', 'OPT']). When omitted, all source keys reported by the remote are exposed. Power/volume/mute/transport keys are never inputs.

irButtons.title: IR Buttons (Optional)
irButtons.description: IR Remote only: optional list of IR key names to expose as HomeKit Switch buttons (tap to fire), e.g. ['VOL+', 'VOL-', 'PLAY', 'PAUSE']. Disabled by default. Warning: enabling Switch buttons makes iOS/Home show a generic tile layout instead of the native Television input picker + speaker controls.

irLabels.title: IR Label Overrides (Optional)
irLabels.description: IR Remote only: display-name overrides keyed by IR key name (e.g. { 'OPT': 'Optical', 'LINE1': 'Line 1' }). Without this, labels are auto-cased from the remote's own names (LINE1 -> Line 1).

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to poll devices for status updates (10-300 seconds)
